phases.label: Calibration/Replay Gates
phases.next_action: Run full calibration diagnostics and post-cost replay gates on finalists. Vary calibration_method (isotonic / sigmoid / temperature / beta — calibrates the SERVED best-base model) as the primary search dimension for this phase. Do NOT vary meta_model, stacking_calibration_*, horizon_ensemble_*, meta_label_*, min_cal_samples / cal_fraction (score-inert under Option A serving), or threshold_strategy (the econ replay applies its own gating policy — threshold changes are score-inert too). Emit metrics.calibration_full_validation and metrics.economic_replay.

phases.label: Multi-Seed Robustness
phases.next_action: Confirm finalist stability via the walk-forward fold metrics (walkforward_auc_cv, fold gates) the best config's run already emitted — this pipeline is deterministic, so do NOT vary seeds or n_seed_trials (inert) and do NOT re-run an unchanged config (dedup rejects it). A robustness probe that IS meaningful here: one small data-window or fold-count perturbation, judged on fold-stability metrics.
